name: Air Force One
description: Follow Air Force One, a tracked concept, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: Rubio, Bessent and Miller Traveled on Decoy Plane From Turkey Without Trump

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump boarded Air Force One last month as usual. But the Washington Post reports he was smuggled off the plane in a catering truck and flew on an entirely different aircraft due to a threat.

changes.title: With Trump Secretly Evacuated, Imperiled Air Force One Became a Flying Decoy
changes.summary: In response to a threat against the jet last month, the president was clandestinely removed in a catering container. But the plane was sent into the skies anyway with government employees and reporters onboard.

changes.title: Trump Says Secret Service Ordered Air Force One Swap
changes.summary: Trump claims his secret plane was in more danger than the Air Force One decoy the public thought Trump was flying on.
